_comment: SuperGenius network configuration. All fields optional with safe defaults.
_is_processor_doc: Whether this node should run processing services. Default: true
_subnet_id_doc: Reserved for future subnet isolation. Default: 0
_bootstrap_fullnodes_doc: Multiaddr strings of bootstrap full nodes for pubsub discovery
_authorized_full_node_doc: Multiaddr string of the authorized full node peer
_ipfs_cache_dir_doc: Directory under base write path for IPFS block flat-file cache. Default: ipfs_cache
_mirror_results_doc: If true, this node fetches and persists processing results from other nodes. Full/archive nodes should set this. Default: false
_result_retention_hours_doc: Hours to retain processing results before GC. 0 = keep forever (full node). Default: 168 (7 days)
_result_retention_max_mb_doc: Max MB for result cache before evicting oldest. 0 = no space cap. Default: 0
